text: Westport Albion triggered a counter-attack via Marek Zielinski’s interception deep in their own half, initiating a rapid vertical progression characterized by short, progressive passes into the final third. Jonah Valdez’s successful carries advanced the ball quickly against Kingsmoor FC’s wide, crossing-heavy 4-4-2 defense, culminating in an overload in the box through a well-executed cross sequence with Dylan Rahman. This deliberate 3-pass, 16.9-second build-up combined vertical penetration and positional patience to create a high-xG (0.261) headed chance, demonstrating effective exploitation of central vertical channels against Kingsmoor’s wide structure. Despite the high-quality chance, goalkeeper Tariq Brennan’s save preserved Westport Albion’s 3-2 lead, underscoring how their direct style can generate clear-cut opportunities but also the importance of transition defence to maintain advantage under pressure.
